image.typeError: Images must be JPG, PNG or WebP
image.done: Uploaded. The image will appear publicly once processing is done
image.hint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Hidden data such as location (EXIF) is removed after upload. Please do not upload photos containing personal information.

itemSheet.name: Name (required)
itemSheet.modeLocked: Someone has already claimed or contributed, so this can no longer be changed.
itemSheet.deadlineHint: If left empty, 23:59 on the event date is used. Required when the list has no event date.
itemSheet.crowdNote: Once the goal is reached, the platform buys and ships it for you. Points are never paid out to you as cash. You need to fill in the list's shipping info first.
itemSheet.fundLocked: The goal was reached or the deadline has passed, so the target and deadline can no longer be changed.
itemSheet.errTarget: Please enter the target points (a positive whole number)
itemSheet.errStale: This item was changed elsewhere. Please reload.
itemSheet.errAddr: Crowdfunded items need shipping info first, so the platform knows where to send it once the goal is reached.
itemSheet.supportNote: Hand this wish to their list; gifts from friends count toward them.

shipping.intro: When a wish crowdfund reaches its goal, the platform buys the item and ships it here. Only you and the staff placing the order can see this. Friends never can.
shipping.empty: Not filled in yet. Lists with crowdfunded items must have this before they can be published.
shipping.phoneLabel: Phone (6–20 characters, may include + - and spaces)
shipping.privacy: To protect your privacy, you need to re-enter everything when making changes.

public.label: Public
public.desc: Anyone can view it (including guests). It is listed on Explore and your profile.

friends.label: All friends
friends.desc: Only your friends can open it, and they need to sign in.

selected.label: Close friends
selected.desc: Only the close friends you pick from your friends can open it, and they need to sign in.

private.label: Private
private.desc: Only you can see it. Friends who open it will see "not found".

vis.noFriendsPost: to invite friends, then come back to pick.

bday.label: Notify friends who can see this list 7 days before my birthday

who.friends: All your friends will be notified.
who.selected: Only the close friends you selected for this list will be notified.

block.required: Add your birthday in Settings to turn this on.
block.private: Your birthday is visible to "only me". Change it in Settings first.
block.listPrivate: A private list notifies no one. Choose another visibility first.

bday.single: Only one list can have this on at a time; turning it on here turns it off for your other lists.
